Package robbery.player

Class PlayerDataManager

java.lang.Object
robbery.player.PlayerDataManager
public class PlayerDataManager extends Object
Manages PlayerData instances for all online players.

Provides methods to get, set, and retrieve the storage folder path for a player. Uses a thread-safe ConcurrentHashMap to store PlayerData instances keyed by the player's UUID string.

    • getPlayerData

      public static PlayerData getPlayerData(org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
      Retrieves the PlayerData for the given player. If the player does not have existing data, a new PlayerData instance is created and stored.
      Parameters:
      p - the player to retrieve data for
      Returns:
      the PlayerData instance associated with the player

    • setPlayerData

      public static void setPlayerData(org.bukkit.entity.Player p, PlayerData m)
      Sets or updates the PlayerData for a player. If the provided PlayerData is null, the player’s data is removed.
      Parameters:
      p - the player whose data is being set
      m - the PlayerData instance to associate with the player, or null to remove
